title: Pressure with depth
caption: Drag the depth and the fluid density and watch the gauge pressure climb in a straight line.

title: Where the buoyant force comes from
caption: The pressure arrows on the bottom face are longer than the ones on the top. That difference, and nothing else, is buoyancy.

title: Float, sink, hover
caption: Set the object density and the fluid density and read off the fraction submerged.

title: U-tube with two liquids
caption: Pour more oil in, or make it lighter, and see how far the water in the far arm rises above the interface.
